preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of distinct subarrays of P modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= j <= n * math.factorial(n) for i in range(1, n * math.factorial(n) + 1) for j in range(i, n * math.factorial(n) + 1) if (P[i-1:i] == P[j-1:j] and i != j) implies (i == j))
postconditions.description: The output counts each distinct subarray of P exactly once, where P is the concatenation of all permutations of [1, 2, ..., n] in lexicographic order. The subarrays are defined by indices 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ n·n!.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == len({tuple(P[i-1:j]) for i in range(1, n * math.factorial(n) + 1) for j in range(i, n * math.factorial(n) + 1)}) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct subarrays of P modulo 998244353, where P is the concatenation of all permutations of [1, 2, ..., n] in lexicographic order.
